title: Web image fit
when_to_use: Generating or placing images for posts/pages (featured, inline, hero) — pick aspect ratio and framing so images fit the web.
principles: Default landscape: use aspect_ratio 16:9 for featured, inline, and hero/post images unless the user asks otherwise.
Use 4:3 only when the user wants a less-wide / classic photo crop, or the scene needs a bit more vertical subject room without going portrait.
Tall (9:16 / 3:4) only when the user explicitly asks for tall, portrait, Story, or phone-tall — never because the subject is a standing person or vertical object.
Square (1:1) only for icons, avatars, logos, or product thumbs — or when the user says square. Never default a post image to 1:1.

Ambiguous “add an image”: landscape 16:9 inline (or top-of-body if there is no lead image). Set featured only when they say featured / thumbnail / cover / social card, or when a new-post brief includes a featured image.

Prompt craft: say framing in the prompt (“wide landscape composition”, “subject in upper two-thirds”, “generous margins”, “not a tall portrait”). Prefer editorial crops that read at ~1200×675; keep text-in-image minimal; always plan alt text.
Out of scope here: site logo/icon strategy, OG/social copy, accessibility alt audits, stock vs generate, theme thumbnail regeneration — use other abilities/playbooks for those.
steps: Decide role: featured vs inline/hero vs intentional square chrome — pick one placement path only.
Pick aspect_ratio from the principles (default 16:9 for post images).
Call ahentic/generate-image with that aspect_ratio and framing baked into the prompt (once).

Place once: if the user asked for featured / thumbnail / cover / social card (or a new-post brief includes featured), use ahentic-browser/set-featured-image when the block editor is open, else ahentic/set-featured-image — and do not also insert the same image into the body.

Otherwise insert a single core/image via ahentic-browser/insert-blocks with {id,url,alt} (index 0 or before_ref of the first block for a lead image). Call insert-blocks once only. Never from_memory on insert-blocks for image artifacts.
anti_patterns: Omitting aspect_ratio and relying on a square default for post/featured/hero images.
Choosing 9:16 or 3:4 because the subject is a person, bottle, or phone UI without an explicit tall/portrait ask.
Defaulting every “add an image” request to featured image.
Inserting the same uploaded image twice (two insert-blocks calls, or featured + body insert) for one generate request.
Putting critical detail at crop edges themes will cut off.
Inserting huge portrait images that dominate the post scroll.
Passing from_memory into insert-blocks for an image artifact.
